problem: Dataset and scientific table previews did not expose one consistent shown/total/paging contract for bounded data.
changes: Added bounded 50-row Dataset Explorer pagination with current range and authoritative total.
Added stable first/last boundary behavior for previous/next controls.
Added current-page range and total-row disclosure to the generic scientific table while preserving maximumRows bounds.
Preserved sample_id/sampleRef semantic identity and selection behavior.
